name: Alif Ramdani
description: I design and ship distributed systems at production scale. API gateways, microservices, high-throughput pipelines, and the LLM-backed products that run on top of them.
about: Backend engineer with 4+ years designing and shipping distributed systems at production scale: API gateways, async task pipelines, data warehouses, and microservice migrations. Deep in Go and Node.js, with hands-on experience integrating AI into real infrastructure: RAG-based Text2SQL, statistical forecasting, and MCP servers that plug AI agents directly into production services. Focused on systems that are observable, reliable, and scalable.
